warnings: Steel pipe trusses: sizes from the pipe table printed on this sheet (ø-32 = 1 1/4" 42.4 x 2.6, ø-40 = 1 1/2" 48.3 x 2.9, ø-65 = 2 1/2" 60.3 x 3.2, ø-100 = 4" 114.3 x 3.6). steel_section keeps the callout's nominal ø (Pipe, d_mm = nominal) with the printed text; the table's outside diameters are in the notes file.

T1 callouts: the 'ø-100 mm. t = 3.6 mm.' leader runs down through the truss to the bottom chord, the 'ø-65 mm. t = 3.2 mm.' leader points at a mid-span diagonal — chords 100, web members 65 as read from the leaders; flagged.
Panel chains (~1.00 x 19, ~1.10 x 10) and depths are truss-internal and stay here (section 4 rule 4 exception); the support-to-support 16.00 and the 5.50 bays are in the grid master.
